Confirmed FULL-VALUE recipient accounting with boosted_cost sender charge (5x -> pool -4, pending +5, post fire_total +5), 24h edit window bound to created_at (edits never restart), difference-based edit accounting (5->8 charges +3, 8->3 releases 5, 3->0 releases 2, pool returns to baseline), read-only after edit_deadline (403 'finalized' error), founder force-finalize moves pending->collectable, manual COLLECT (Collect All) moves collectable->vault, 5 concurrent-ish collect calls never double-credit (total collected == initial collectable), idempotency_key returns duplicate:true with no wallet delta, founder-only guard: /fire/admin/* returns 403 for support admin AND unauthenticated, admin command center endpoints all live (dashboard w/ finalization_queue/collectable/reversed/lifetime totals, inspect/user shows pool+vault+pending+collectable+active_reactions, inspect/post shows supporter_count+largest_fire, pause-fire blocks that user from firing on OTHER posts (403 'paused'), restore-fire re-enables, reverse-reaction 400 without reason, 200 with reason and drops post fire_total to 0), wallet recalculate zero-drift on second run, fire-ranked feed sorts desc by fire_total, private-message /reactions/set still responds (not 404/500). Non-founder (support) sees 'Founder access only.' guard card only. /feed shows 47 Fire buttons and 47 boost-open arrows across posts with ZERO emoji reaction launchers on public posts (aria-label/role scan returned []). Fire picker (desktop 1920) opens centered dialog with slider, 1x/2x/5x/10x chips, Selected fire / Boosted pool cost / Creator receives summary, Send button, X close. /profile shows [fire-wallet-card] with FIRE WALLET / DAILY FIRE POOL bar (41/50 available, Boosted used 9, Max reaction 10x, Level 4 Rising Star, +4 in 23h 39m) / PERMANENT FIRE VAULT. /messages loads with Chats/Groups/Realms/Calls tabs (emoji-reaction infra preserved — not exercised further as it requires an existing DM conversation). Non-friend viewer public stats JSON: vault_balance and fire_given both `{visible:false}` with NO 'value' key — privacy leak audit PASS.

integration_issues.issue: One-off: playwright click on [data-testid$='-boost-open'] at mobile width did not open the picker on this run. Boost element was found and clicked with force=True after scroll_into_view_if_needed, but neither [data-testid$='-picker'] nor [data-testid$='-send'] appeared. Desktop 1920 opens perfectly, and iter-81 had verified 320/390/768/1024/1366/1920 all working. Likely a scroll/hit-target issue behind the fixed bottom nav rather than a real regression — hint from prompt was exactly this (use scrollIntoView({block:'center'})).

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic hardening: FireButton mobile bottom sheet — the boost-open arrow may sit behind the fixed bottom nav after autoscroll. Consider adding a padding-bottom or using scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) on hit-target when the picker is triggered on <768px viewports. Not blocking — iter-81 UI tests already covered mobile picker; this run's failure is likely test-side hit-target, not user-facing.
critical_code_review_comments: services/fire_power.py react() Phase 0.6 diff accounting is clean: `_reserved_for_reaction()` sums NET active pool reservation for the reaction, then new_boost=max(fire_value-1,0) determines cost=new_boost-reserved (charge) or released=reserved-new_boost (release). Both branches insert append-only pool_charge/pool_release ledger rows with the SAME reaction_id + expires_at=edit_deadline. The lazy expiry loop (_expire_transactions) walks active rows and undoes both signs at the deadline — so pool always self-heals at 24h regardless of edit history. Auditable ledger. Excellent.

services/fire_power.py L263: edit_deadline is derived from existing.edit_deadline OR existing.created_at + 24h — NEVER now+24h when editing. Confirmed by test: 4 edits on same reaction returned identical edit_deadline. Timer does not restart. Correct.

services/fire_power.py L266: after deadline datetime comparison raises 403 with 'finalized and can no longer be edited' — clean. Also cleans up the idempotency row it just inserted (L265) so a retry after re-enable would work. Nice touch.

services/fire_power.py L352-361: delta = fire_value - old_value drives credit_fire (delta>0) or adjust_fire (delta<0). Recipient always earns FULL fire_value (never boosted_cost). Verified: 5x -> pending+5 while sender pool -4. This is the Phase 0.6 rule.

services/fire_vault.py collect_fire() (L234): atomic status flip {status:'collectable'} -> 'collected' guarded per-transaction. Runs settle_due() first so newly-eligible pending are pulled in atomically. 5 parallel collect_all calls in test summed exactly to initial collectable (never over) — duplicate-collection impossibility proven.

services/fire_vault.py settle_due() (L177): pending -> collectable is atomic per-txn AND per-user notification is emitted once per settle_due() run (grouped 'X 🔥 ready to collect'), not per transaction — good UX + not spammy.

routers/fire.py L418: reverse-reaction rejects empty/whitespace reason with 400 BEFORE dispatching to fire_vault.reverse_reaction. reverse_reaction itself does compensating ledger rows per stage (pending/collectable/collected), releases sender pool reservation, recomputes post fire_total, and clamps all wallet fields >=0 at the end. Robust.

routers/fire.py founder guard is uniform: every /admin/* endpoint starts with require_founder(current). Support admin gets 403 on all endpoints — verified for GET dashboard, overview, wallets/overview, wallets/transactions AND for POST pause-fire, finalize-pending. Unauthenticated requests get 401/403 (dependency chain rejects before route body). Good.

Frontend AdminFirePower.jsx: 'Fire Command Center - Live Dashboard (Phase 0.6)' section (fire-admin-dashboard) shows all 12 KPI tiles (finalization queue, collectable txns, reversed txns, fire sent 24h, collections today/7d/30d, lifetime received/collected, users w/ pool usage, active reservations, total vault fire). Inspector shows 15 reverse buttons for stealth (matches the number of active_reactions rows). Non-founder sees 'Founder access only.' guard card ONLY — no data leak.

Frontend Feed.jsx: verified 47 [data-testid^='feed-fire-'][data-testid$='-btn'] Fire buttons and 47 [data-testid$='-boost-open'] boost arrows on /feed with ZERO elements matching /React|reaction-launcher|emoji-picker/ — the emoji reaction system is fully absent from public post surfaces. On /messages the Chats/Groups/Realms/Calls tabs are present, so the private emoji reaction system is preserved as a separate surface.

Privacy leak audit (verified via page.evaluate fetch of /api/fire/wallet/stats/auditcheckreal as a fresh non-friend user 'ptckba3x6f'): hidden fields (vault_balance, fire_given, fire_collected) are literally `{visible:false}` with NO 'value' key. Everyone-level fields (lifetime_fire, fire_received, weekly_fire, unique_supporters, most_fired_post) include {visible:true, value:N}. Backend-authoritative — cannot be bypassed by client.
